cause_quote: The new `talk.client.say` handler called `requirePreparedTalkSessionTarget(request.sessionMutationAuthorization?.talkSessionTarget)` even though the administrator bypass left that target unset.
user_saw: After connecting successfully, an administrator-scoped voice device could not speak the submitted reply because the Gateway returned “Talk session target was not prepared by the Gateway.”
summary: The fix makes the Gateway prepare the Talk session target for administrator speech requests.
reasoning: The introducing diff added `talk.client.say` and required a prepared target from its first version. At that commit, the administrator bypass returned before target resolution for this request, so the new speech method already failed for administrator clients when it shipped.
